pins.name: DQ
pins.notes: Yellow (sometimes white) wire. Needs a 4.7 kΩ pull-up to 3.3 V

gotchas.text: It needs a 4.7 kΩ pull-up resistor between DATA and VCC. Without it the sensor is not found.
A 12-bit reading takes up to 750 ms. Code that waits less gets the last value, or 85 °C (the power-on value).

source.title: Maxim DS18B20 datasheet
source.section: Temperature conversion time 750 ms max; power-on reset value +85 °C

current.note: 1 mA during a conversion, 750 nA standby.

source.title: Maxim DS18B20 datasheet
source.section: DC electrical characteristics: IDD active 1 mA typ (1.5 mA max); IDDS 750 nA

sources.title: Maxim DS18B20 datasheet
sources.section: Pin description: GND, DQ, VDD; DQ needs a pull-up of about 4.7 kΩ
